title: Gothic Punk Selfie
description: A cyberpunk demon with horns and glowing purple energy stands in a stone archway, flanked by two women in matching pink leather outfits. One woman crouches aggressively with a pistol while the other lounges on a pink bed taking a selfie with a peace sign.
prompt: A dramatic scene set in front of a gothic cathedral with pink stained glass. In the center, a tall blue demonic figure with horns and a long pink coat emerges from a glowing archway. To the left, a woman in shiny pink leather armor and mohawk crouches with a gun. To the right, another woman in pink outfit and keffiyeh lies on a pink satin bed taking a selfie, making a peace sign. Vibrant pink and purple color scheme with graffiti on stone walls.
